title: Now useless
text:
Now useless. Its cute and sturdy. Half the time the asked fall outside the bowl but my sticks might not be perfectly straight so I'm not discounting it for that.

My big problem is day 3, the stick burned to the bottom like it should however the stick stuck in the little hole and I cannot get it out so its pretty much just a decorative bowl at this point. Im not sure how to get it out or prevent this from happening again. So my advice is keep an eye on the stick when it gets to the bottom of its burn life.
